runtime_reviews.title: Poring War battlefield rule cycle
runtime_reviews.summary: The Poring War script removes party-lock and PvP flags during initialization and reset, enables them when the match timer reaches 100 seconds, then removes them on a win or at the 700-second timeout.
conditions: The match timer is started when both teams register; the first team waits for the opposing team before the master timer starts.
At timer 100 seconds, the script applies party lock, PvP, no-guild PvP, and no-calculation-rank flags.
The script removes these flags on a win, reset, or timer 700 seconds. These are source-defined event transitions, not a live observation of the map's current state.
runtime_reviews.review_method: Traced the loaded Poring War NPC's team-registration callbacks, initialization/reset handlers, timed start, win handler, and timeout handler; validated every cited literal call against the active script.
